migration_steps.activity: Establish PQC program office, governance, and executive sponsorship; define scope for VPN, email, and document signing; assign roles and RACI.

Conduct comprehensive cryptographic inventory discovery using automated network scanning, endpoint agents, and configuration audits to replace outdated inventory; classify data flows and cryptographic dependencies.
prerequisites: Network access and scanning approvals obtained

migration_steps.activity: Perform risk assessment and gap analysis against NIST FIPS 203/204/205 requirements; identify all RSA-4096 and ECDSA usage in VPN, email, and document signing.
Engage Cisco and Microsoft for formal PQC roadmap commitments, firmware/software support statements, and timelines; request evidence of FIPS 203/204/205 validation plans.
prerequisites: Procurement and legal review of vendor NDAs

migration_steps.activity: Develop PQC migration architecture and design documents for hybrid and pure PQC modes; define algorithm roles (ML-KEM for key establishment, ML-DSA for signatures) and fallback strategies.
prerequisites: Vendor roadmap inputs received (even if preliminary)

migration_steps.activity: Procure PQC-capable test equipment, software licenses, and professional services for lab environment; establish isolated PQC test lab.

Conduct PQC interoperability and performance testing in lab using available NIST-standardized algorithm implementations (e.g., OpenSSL, BoringSSL with ML-KEM/ML-DSA) for VPN, email, and document signing prototypes.
prerequisites: Change freeze Nov 15-Jan 15 respected (lab activities only if permitted; otherwise schedule after freeze)

migration_steps.activity: Develop training program for technical team on PQC fundamentals, FIPS 203/204/205, and migration procedures; conduct initial training sessions.

Evaluate and select PQC-capable replacement solutions for Cisco routers (e.g., software-based VPN gateways or next-gen routers with PQC support) and for Microsoft Exchange (e.g., third-party PQC email gateways or hybrid solutions) based on vendor responses and lab results.
Develop detailed migration plan, rollback procedures, and change management plan for production deployment; schedule within change freeze windows.
Pilot PQC migration for a limited subset of VPN, email, and document signing users using selected solutions; validate operational performance and security.
Phase 1 production rollout: migrate VPN infrastructure to PQC-capable solution (ML-KEM for key establishment) for all users, respecting change freeze.
Phase 2 production rollout: migrate email signing/encryption to PQC (ML-DSA for signatures, ML-KEM for key establishment) using available solutions or Microsoft plugin when released.
prerequisites: Microsoft PQC plugin released and validated (or alternative solution deployed)

migration_steps.activity: Phase 3 production rollout: migrate document signing to PQC (ML-DSA) across all document management systems.
Decommission legacy RSA-4096 and ECDSA systems; conduct final compliance audit and certification against FIPS 203/204/205; update inventory and documentation.

blockers.blocker: Cisco routers do not support firmware upgrades for PQC
blockers.reason: Hardware lacks capability to implement ML-KEM/ML-DSA; no firmware path available, requiring hardware replacement or alternative solutions.
blockers.resolution_required: Cisco must provide a hardware replacement roadmap with PQC support, or agency must procure alternative PQC-capable VPN gateways; evidence of FIPS 203/204/205 validation required.

blockers.blocker: Microsoft Exchange PQC plugin not yet released
blockers.reason: Email signing and encryption cannot be migrated to PQC without vendor support; timeline uncertain.
blockers.resolution_required: Microsoft must release and validate a PQC plugin for Exchange supporting ML-DSA and ML-KEM; agency must obtain evidence of FIPS validation and test in lab.

blockers.reason: Cannot accurately scope migration or identify all cryptographic dependencies without complete inventory.
blockers.resolution_required: Conduct comprehensive automated discovery and manual audits; update inventory database with all cryptographic assets and data flows.

blockers.blocker: Technical team has zero PQC experience
blockers.reason: Lack of knowledge may lead to design errors, misconfiguration, or delays.
blockers.resolution_required: Implement training program, hire external PQC experts, and engage professional services for knowledge transfer.

blockers.blocker: Mandate requires only NIST-standardized algorithms (FIPS 203/204/205) by 2030
blockers.reason: Any solution must be validated to these standards; non-compliant solutions cannot be used.
blockers.resolution_required: Ensure all procured solutions have FIPS 203/204/205 validation or are on a clear path to validation; obtain certification evidence.

blockers.blocker: Change freeze from Nov 15 to Jan 15
blockers.reason: Production changes cannot occur during freeze, limiting deployment windows.
blockers.resolution_required: Schedule all production changes outside freeze periods; plan for extended timelines.

vendor_dependencies.pqc_support_status: No current firmware upgrade path for PQC on existing routers; future hardware roadmap unconfirmed.
vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: Formal statement of PQC support roadmap, FIPS 203/204/205 validation certificates for replacement hardware, and migration guidance.

vendor_dependencies.pqc_support_status: PQC plugin for Exchange not yet released; timeline unconfirmed.
vendor_dependencies.evidence_required: Release date commitment, FIPS 203/204/205 validation evidence, and interoperability test results.

algorithm_roles.ML-KEM: Post-quantum key establishment (encryption) for VPN tunnels and email encryption; used to negotiate shared secrets resistant to quantum attacks.
algorithm_roles.ML-DSA: Post-quantum digital signatures for document signing and email authentication; used to verify integrity and authenticity.

raw_response.confidence: Low to Medium: High uncertainty due to unconfirmed vendor roadmaps, missing Microsoft plugin, and incomplete inventory; timeline may extend beyond 2030 if vendor support is delayed.
